title: Entity screenshot selection
responsibility: Selects matching recorded screenshots and builds gallery items while retaining capture provenance and explicit gaps.

inputs.name: screenOptions.scenarios
inputs.description: Declarations of the scenarios that cover the entity; only a scenario with at least one viewport becomes a choice, and each choice keeps only the states whose coverage is 'required'.

inputs.name: screenPick.options
inputs.description: The scenario choices to pick from, as screenOptions returns them; when no option has the wanted scenario, the first option is used, and an empty list makes screenPick return null.

inputs.name: screenPick.wanted
inputs.description: The requested scenario, state and viewport, each optional; a value that is absent or not among the available choices falls back to the first choice at its level.

inputs.name: entityScreens.evidence
inputs.description: The evidence the screen is read from: only `after` in current mode, and in commit mode `before` too, where a null `before` takes `initial` as its gap note when `initial` is set.

inputs.name: entityScreens.pick
inputs.description: The scenario, state and viewport to show from each side; null makes each side's screen a gap with no scenario named.

inputs.name: catalogShot.evidence
inputs.description: The evidence of one entity at the shown revision; only `after.captures` is read, and without a preview every usable screenshot with media in it is a candidate.

inputs.name: catalogShot.preview
inputs.description: The exact scenario, state and viewport the catalog image must show; when it is absent, any usable screenshot with media qualifies, preferring a capture of the shown commit's build. When it is set and no usable screenshot matches it, the result is null unless allowFocusedDefault permits a focused capture.

inputs.name: catalogShot.allowFocusedDefault
inputs.description: When true and no usable screenshot matches the preview (or none exists), the usable focused captures are used instead; the default false returns null in that case. A focused capture grants no full verification verdict.

inputs.name: galleryItems.evidence
inputs.description: The evidence whose captures become gallery items: `after` always, and `before` too in commit mode; only screenshot and audio captures are included.

outputs.name: screenOptions
outputs.description: One choice per scenario with at least one viewport, each with its title, its required states, and its viewports labeled by their capitalized id and sized as `width × height`.

outputs.name: screenPick
outputs.description: The resolved scenario, state and viewport, or null when there are no options; a level with no available choice becomes an empty string.

outputs.name: entityScreens
outputs.description: `after` is the shown revision's capture or its gap, `before` is the parent's capture or gap in commit mode only, and `fresh` is true only when `after` is a current capture. `origin` names the commit an inherited `after` capture was taken at; an unusable capture is a gap in current mode and an item with its standing in commit mode.

outputs.name: galleryItems
outputs.description: Every screenshot and audio capture of the evidence as an item with its `order`: `before` items first in commit mode, then `after` items, or `current` items alone. Each item carries the standing and provenance its own record gives it, including unusable or inherited captures, and its `source` is the revision its own build names, if any.

An inherited capture keeps its original standing, source and explanation, and the parent side is never read.
